title: Prawns in Spicy Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired stew made with succulent prawns. Serve with steamed rice for a delicious and filling meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add lemongrass and galangal and cook until fragrant.
Add prawns and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add Thai chilies, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar. Stir to combine.
Pour in stew and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 5-7 minutes or until the stew has thickened slightly.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with fresh cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
